status: PHASE 2C COMPUTATIONAL SENSITIVITY / NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION OR FLIGHT CLEARANCE

cases.label: Clean reference / Ncrit 9
cases.interpretation: Reference natural-transition XFOIL case matching the existing Phase 2 clean-surface assumption.

cases.label: Moderately disturbed / Ncrit 6
cases.interpretation: Earlier natural transition proxy for a noisier or less ideal boundary-layer environment; not a calibrated roughness height.

cases.label: Strongly disturbed / Ncrit 3
cases.interpretation: Strong transition-disturbance proxy; not a calibrated physical surface-roughness model.

cases.label: Forced transition at 10% chord
cases.interpretation: Early-transition contamination proxy with transition forced at x/c=0.10 on both surfaces.

cases.label: Forced transition at 5% chord
cases.interpretation: Severe early-transition contamination proxy with transition forced at x/c=0.05 on both surfaces.

validation_boundary: Ncrit variation and forced transition are boundary-layer sensitivity proxies, not calibrated physical roughness-height models.
The blade geometry remains fixed at the Phase 2 reference seed; it is not reoptimized for degraded cases.
The thrust-recovery sweep uses 0.5-rpm resolution so small thrust deficits are not exaggerated by a coarse RPM grid.
No result establishes real surface contamination losses, blade structural safety, aeroelastic stability, airworthiness, or flight safety.
